entries.name: farm
entries.description: A grain farm with a low barn cluster and one tall silo. For a five-tile site, broad grain fields surround a small central two-tile farmyard; for a two-tile core, ONLY the barn, silo and simple farmyard are shown.

entries.name: food plant
entries.description: An eighty metre food processing compound: multiple long low cream halls with broad green roofs, several silver silos and four loading docks.

entries.name: oil well
entries.description: An eighty metre oil pump compound: three distinct pumpjacks, three storage tanks, small maintenance sheds and quiet sandy hardstanding.

entries.name: refinery
entries.description: An eighty metre refinery compound: an array of large rounded storage tanks and tall distillation towers linked by broad essential pipes, low scale-correct office.

entries.name: quarry
entries.description: An eighty metre pale stone quarry: three broad stepped excavation benches, a bold conveyor and small shed, two correctly scaled quarry excavators; no tiny individual stone pattern.

entries.name: cement works
entries.description: An eighty metre cement works: several tall silver silos, a long processing shed, broad essential conveyor and quiet loading yard.

entries.name: sand pit
entries.description: An eighty metre sand pit: broad stepped ochre excavation with a clear conveyor, a small equipment shed and correctly scaled excavator.

entries.name: glassworks
entries.description: An eighty metre glass works: broad green glazed production halls, two brick furnace halls with one chimney, four loading docks.

entries.name: copper mine
entries.description: An eighty metre copper mine: broad red-brown excavated benches, tall winding tower, low crushing shed and copper-colored ore heaps.

direction: Each sprite is a full fixed-scale parcel seen from the same camera. Keep a large transparent border, no shadows crossing the cell. The ground parcel is a broad 2:1 diamond, centered horizontally; its FRONT point lies at90percent cell height. A5tile compound is80m wide, personnel doors must be tiny4.5px high in a256px cell, loading bays9px high. Make buildings into several long wings rather than a giant single cottage. Prioritize large roof masses and industry silhouette. No textures made of tiny high-contrast marks.
